title: Owner's brief - 10-marla house, Allama Iqbal Town
summary: Double-storey family house of about 3,400 sq ft covered area for Mr. Kashif Mehmood: four bedrooms with attached baths, drawing and dining, lounge, kitchen, car porch and roof terrace, built to the LDA-approved map.

format.energy: Building Code of Pakistan, Energy Provisions 2011

requirements.attribute: Number of bedrooms with attached bath

requirements.source_ref: Building Code of Pakistan, Seismic Provisions 2007

programme.label: Covered area, ground and first floor

topics.site_analysis: Corner-free 10-marla plot on a 30 ft street, setbacks per the LDA table for the plot size.
topics.supply: LESCO single-phase connection with a 5 kW solar system and net metering, Sui gas for kitchen and geysers, WASA water with an underground tank and overhead tank.
topics.building_structure: RCC frame with 9 inch brick walls in cement sand mortar, RCC slabs with mud phuska, thermopore and tile roofing.
topics.construction_method: Grey structure by Ravi Homes on labour and material basis, finishes package bought by the owner.
topics.commissioning_sequence: Water and gas tested before the plaster, solar and net metering after the LESCO meter change, LDA completion certificate last.

studies.title: Soil investigation, two boreholes
studies.scope: Two boreholes to 6 m, bearing capacity and water table.
studies.author: Engr. Bilal Hussain Consulting
studies.result: Silty clay with an allowable bearing capacity of about 1.0 tsf at 5 ft. Water table below 20 ft.

studies.title: Solar and net metering
studies.scope: Roof area, shading and the LESCO net metering requirements.
studies.author: Shalimar Electric and Sanitary
studies.result: The roof takes a 5 kW array without shading from the stair tower. Net metering needs a three-phase meter from LESCO.

issue_note: Owner's brief agreed with the architect and Ravi Homes.
